title: Bounded notable coordinates
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, let $T$ be a table of functions from the $q$-dimensional sign cube to $[-1,1]$, let $\varepsilon\in\mathbb R$, and fix a vertex $v$. The notable coordinates are those $i\in\{1,\ldots,q\}$ for which the stable influence, at noise parameter $1-\varepsilon$, of coordinate $i$ in the function $T(v)$ is at least $\varepsilon/2$.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$
$T$ is a table of functions from the $q$-dimensional sign cube to $[-1,1]$
